Test Case Description: Verify Standing Instruction Type module loads successfully
Preconditions: User is logged in with access to Account Utilities
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Start > Account Utilities > Standing Instruction Type | 2. Wait for page load completion | 3. Verify the form sections, action panel, and message panel are visible
Expected Result: Standing Instruction Type screen loads without console errors and the full layout is displayed correctly

Test Case Description: Verify default VIEW mode button and field states on initial load
Preconditions: Module is opened successfully
Test Steps: 1. Open Standing Instruction Type | 2. Inspect form field editability and action buttons
Expected Result: Fields are non-editable in VIEW mode, successful and failure transaction lookups are disabled, SI Type lookup is enabled, and Save stays disabled until Add or Edit is selected

Test Case Description: Verify section headers collapse and expand their content
Preconditions: Module is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Toggle each section header to collapse | 2. Toggle again to expand
Expected Result: Each section hides and shows content correctly while updating the chevron icon and aria-expanded state

Test Case Description: Verify SI Type lookup search and selection
Preconditions: Module is in VIEW mode
Test Steps: 1. Click the SI Type lookup icon | 2. Search for an existing instruction type | 3. Select a row
Expected Result: Instruction Type ID and description fields are populated from the selected search result

Test Case Description: Verify View action loads an existing Standing Instruction Type by entered ID
Preconditions: A valid Standing Instruction Type ID exists
Test Steps: 1. Enter a valid Instruction Type ID | 2. Click View | 3. Review all form sections
Expected Result: Existing data loads successfully, audit fields are populated when available, and the module remains in VIEW mode

Test Case Description: Verify View action warns when Instruction Type ID is blank
Preconditions: Instruction Type ID field is empty and no record is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Open the module fresh | 2. Click View
Expected Result: System clears the form, stays in VIEW mode, and shows a warning prompting the user to enter an Instruction Type ID

Test Case Description: Verify missing-record flow enables Add from VIEW mode
Preconditions: A non-existing Instruction Type ID is known
Test Steps: 1. Enter a non-existing Instruction Type ID | 2. Click View | 3. Observe button states and feedback
Expected Result: System keeps the entered ID, shows a warning that the record was not found, and enables Add so the user can create the new record

Test Case Description: Verify Add action preserves a typed missing Instruction Type ID
Preconditions: A non-existing Instruction Type ID was entered in VIEW mode
Test Steps: 1. Enter a new Instruction Type ID | 2. Click View until record-not-found state is shown | 3. Click Add
Expected Result: Form enters ADD mode and retains the typed Instruction Type ID so the user can create the missing record

Test Case Description: Verify Add action clears the form for a new entry when no ID was pre-entered
Preconditions: No record is loaded and Instruction Type ID field is blank
Test Steps: 1. Click Add | 2. Inspect form state
Expected Result: Form is cleared, editable inputs become enabled, transaction lookups are enabled, and Save plus Cancel become available

Test Case Description: Verify successful transaction lookup populates transaction fields
Preconditions: User is in Add or Edit mode
Test Steps: 1. Click the Successful Transaction lookup icon | 2. Search for a valid transaction description | 3. Select a row
Expected Result: Successful Transaction ID and transaction description fields populate with the selected lookup values

Test Case Description: Verify failure transaction lookup populates transaction fields
Preconditions: User is in Add or Edit mode
Test Steps: 1. Click the Failure Transaction lookup icon | 2. Search for a valid transaction description | 3. Select a row
Expected Result: Failure Transaction ID and transaction description fields populate with the selected lookup values

Test Case Description: Create a new Standing Instruction Type with valid data
Preconditions: User is in Add mode with valid transfer type and optional transaction references available
Test Steps: 1. Click Add | 2. Enter Instruction Type ID, description, transfer type, retry settings, charge type, narrations, and optional transaction IDs | 3. Click Save
Expected Result: Record is saved successfully, success feedback is shown, and the created record can be reloaded in VIEW mode

Test Case Description: Verify Freeze Amount On Failure checkbox is persisted through save and reload
Preconditions: User is in Add or Edit mode
Test Steps: 1. Tick Freeze Amount On Failure | 2. Save the record | 3. Reload the same record
Expected Result: Checkbox state is sent as 1 on save and reloads as checked when the backend returns the freeze flag

Test Case Description: Verify Edit action is available only after a record is loaded
Preconditions: No Standing Instruction Type record is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Open the module fresh | 2. Attempt to use Edit if available
Expected Result: Edit remains unavailable until a record has been loaded in VIEW mode

Test Case Description: Verify Edit mode keeps Instruction Type ID locked
Preconditions: An existing Standing Instruction Type record is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Load a record | 2. Click Edit | 3. Inspect the Instruction Type ID field
Expected Result: Instruction Type ID remains disabled in EDIT mode while other editable controls are enabled

Test Case Description: Update an existing Standing Instruction Type successfully
Preconditions: An existing record is loaded in VIEW mode
Test Steps: 1. Click Edit | 2. Change editable values such as description, retries, charge type, or narrations | 3. Click Save
Expected Result: Record updates successfully, success feedback is shown, and latest values are visible after reload

Test Case Description: Verify update flow preserves original created metadata
Preconditions: An existing record with Created By and Created On metadata is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Load a record | 2. Click Edit | 3. Change one field | 4. Save | 5. Reload the record
Expected Result: Update request preserves original created metadata while modified metadata is refreshed by the backend

Test Case Description: Verify delete passes update count and removes the record
Preconditions: An existing record with a known UpdateCount is loaded and user has delete rights
Test Steps: 1. Load a record | 2. Click Delete | 3. Confirm the delete dialog | 4. Inspect the request if network tools are available
Expected Result: Delete request includes SITypeID and update count fields and the record is removed successfully

Test Case Description: Verify delete is cancelled when user declines confirmation
Preconditions: An existing record is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Click Delete | 2. Choose No or Cancel in the confirmation dialog
Expected Result: No delete API call is made and the existing record remains loaded unchanged

Test Case Description: Verify Cancel clears the form and returns module to VIEW mode
Preconditions: User is in Add or Edit mode with unsaved values
Test Steps: 1. Enter or change values | 2. Click Cancel
Expected Result: Form is cleared, unsaved changes are discarded, and the module returns to VIEW mode

Test Case Description: Verify refresh reloads the currently loaded record
Preconditions: A Standing Instruction Type record is currently loaded
Test Steps: 1. Load a record | 2. Click the window refresh action
Expected Result: The module reloads the current record using the saved search key and refreshes displayed values

Test Case Description: Verify refresh clears the form when no record is loaded
Preconditions: No record is loaded
Test Steps: 1. Open the module with an empty form | 2. Click the window refresh action
Expected Result: Form stays cleared and the module remains in VIEW mode

Test Case Description: Verify close action prompts when unsaved changes exist
Preconditions: User is in Add or Edit mode with unsaved changes
Test Steps: 1. Modify one or more fields | 2. Click the window close action
Expected Result: System prompts for confirmation before closing or redirecting because unsaved changes are present

Test Case Description: Verify audit fields render for a loaded record
Preconditions: An existing Standing Instruction Type record contains audit data
Test Steps: 1. Load a record | 2. Expand Behind The Scene | 3. Review Created By, Created On, Modified By, Modified On, and Supervised By fields
Expected Result: Audit values are displayed when returned by the backend and default to placeholder dashes when absent

Test Case Description: Verify SI Transfer Type and Failed Charge Type dropdown values populate from saved record
Preconditions: An existing Standing Instruction Type record contains transfer type and failed charge type values
Test Steps: 1. Load a record | 2. Inspect SI Transfer Type and Failed Charge Type fields
Expected Result: Dropdowns reflect the saved backend values whether they arrive as primary IDs or mapped aliases

Test Case Description: Verify successful and failure narration fields persist through save and reload
Preconditions: User is in Add or Edit mode
Test Steps: 1. Enter narrations for successful and failure processing | 2. Save the record | 3. Reload the same record
Expected Result: Narration fields persist correctly and reload with the saved values

Test Case Description: Verify unauthorized session is handled gracefully by the API flow
Preconditions: User session is expired or user is not authenticated
Test Steps: 1. Attempt View, Save, or Delete after session expiry | 2. Observe user feedback
Expected Result: Backend returns unauthorized response and the module surfaces failure feedback instead of reporting success

Test Case Description: Verify loading overlay and feedback messages during data operations
Preconditions: A View, Save, or Delete action is triggered
Test Steps: 1. Perform a data operation | 2. Observe the loading overlay and resulting message or notification
Expected Result: Loading overlay is visible during request processing and a success, warning, or error message is shown after completion
